findings.description: Step 6 `isNextDisabled` is hardcoded `false` — the Continue button is never visually disabled on the Rooms step, even when no rooms exist or rooms fail validation. Set `isNextDisabled={!allRoomsValid}` on StepShell to match the UX contract of every other step.

`submit()` is a no-op — it only flips a local boolean and clears the password; no data reaches any backend. The success screen copy ('Your property is now pending verification') implies a real submission. Wire up the API call before shipping or change the copy to make clear submission is deferred.

Step 8 does not gate submission on required verification documents. A user can clear a required document after step 3 and submit from step 8 despite the inline red warning. Add a check that all `required` verification docs have a file before calling `submit()`.

`(e.target as HTMLInputElement).value` casts are used throughout step pages instead of `e.currentTarget.value`, which TypeScript already types correctly given `FormField`'s prop signature. Switch to `e.currentTarget.value` to remove the suppressive casts.
